_comment: Per-document coordinate systems for holes whose pages do not print a parseable system. Every entry is an ASSUMPTION (crs_status = assumed) with its evidence; the map must say so. epsg may be a list: the first candidate whose transform lands inside its area of use is used. axis: xy | yx | auto.

AF01.PDF.evidence: prints WGS84 with latitude in the X column (Zwelitsha, South Africa: -32.93, 27.44)

AF02.pdf.evidence: location 'MARRUECOS' (Morocco), UTM-sized numbers; zone 29N puts the holes on the Atlantic coast near Agadir at the printed 11-19 m elevation

EUR01.pdf.evidence: Damhusaaen, Valby (Copenhagen): pages print either S34S (System 34 Sjaelland, west-orientated) or UTM32E89 (ETRS89 / UTM 32N); pages without the label use whichever candidate places the point on Zealand

EUR02.pdf.evidence: 'Preston Bathing Waters' for United Utilities (Fugro); 'mE/mN' six-digit pairs are British National Grid and land in Preston

FullReport02.pdf.evidence: Hunua 4 watermain, Auckland; pages print NZTM / NZGD2000 with northing first, some print 'N/A'

MEA01.pdf.evidence: Arad Fort / Hidd, Bahrain; Ain el Abd / UTM 39N is the Bahrain grid; the numbers land on Muharraq at the printed 2-3 m elevation

NAM02.pdf.evidence: Coquitlam and Surrey, BC (Golder); 'Ground UTM' = NAD83 / UTM 10N, which puts the holes in Coquitlam

Report01.pdf.evidence: Artillery Drive, Papakura (Auckland Council); the six-digit pairs are the Mount Eden 2000 circuit and land on Artillery Drive

SAM02.docx.evidence: Praca Sete, Belo Horizonte MG (Portuguese SPT logs); SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 23S puts the holes in central Belo Horizonte at the printed 850 m elevation

SEA01.pdf.evidence: KOGAS Jinhae-Geoje pipeline (Korean); Korea 2000 / East Belt 2010 with northing printed first puts the marine holes between Jinhae and Geoje

FullReport01.pdf.evidence: Al Kuwayfiyah, Benghazi (Libya): six-digit pairs are a local site grid (northing 321239 cannot be UTM at 32 N); the project grid definition is needed

SAM01.pdf.evidence: Colector Margen Izquierda, Buenos Aires: 44559 / 24600 is a local city grid, not Gauss-Krueger; the project grid definition is needed

ToughOne1.pdf.evidence: Grefsen, Oslo: 'Geoido' local grid (4893 / 4892); the project grid definition is needed
